lines: Friday 13 November 2015 after the Terrorism in Paris The next day, 14 November 2015 The next day, 14 November 2015 Journalist Hendra travels 500 KM from Germany toward Paris Sunday 15 November 2015 I am looking for the concert hall, that was the location of hte terrorist attack last Friday night in Paris

There was a music performance in the concert hall. Then suddenly a few people started to shoot all over. Then people ran outside, and there was a video on TV that we saw when people ran out from the back door. So from that backdoor they ran, the ones who had been shot fell, the others ran out,

and then there were dead bodies in front of the door, the others were able to save themselves, there were also people limping because there legs were shot. From there we saw shooting in all directions, then there was an explosion inside. And we suspected that at that moment the perpetrator killed blew himself up.

And the victims killed were around 80 people shot inside the concert hall, it was one of the most popular concert halls in the city of paris. This is Bataclan, the area, a street view. This is one of the centers of the terror attacks. And this is close for French people pause this is a big place for the Republic.

Ok. Now we are going to go directly there to see what there is at that location. So, this is the city of Paris, a city which is actually very enjoyable, especially if we come in the mornings or Sundays here, too eat a relaxed breakfast ....and have a coffee. The police have just passed, this Sunday is a regular day to meet with my friends to sit around to talk.

But today is also an event that terrifies the citizens of Paris. And, when we came last night, we really felt the atmosphere of shock in this city. Because Saturday night the streets were quiet, the busy places which usually have traffic jams were deserted. Lots of police today experienced lalang. This is something that is very interesting, we just saw, there is a restaurant

This restaurant is named Himalaya, this is an Indian and Pakistani restaurang, because we know that those two countrries are enemies bebuyutan, but in Paris they can make a restaurant that is Indian and Pakistani. This is the French newspaper with high circulation L'Express and e Parisien, today is all about the terror attacks that happened on Friday

and this is the news from last night that is the most accurate version, 129 people died, 350 people were wounded. A national tragedy for France, this is from the newspaper Le Figaro. A special edition about the terror attacks if we keep going straight there is one of the locations of the terror attacks and we see here, the media gather here includding CNBC and others.

I see people in front there have flowers, they place the flowers there or they write messages or whatever we see there in the front. We are now at the Place of the Republic, this is the real symbol of the French Revolution, , the monument behind me holds the symbolic meaning of the three mottos of the French Revolution: Liberty, Fraternity and Equality.

This has a symbolic meaning of freedom, equality and brotherhood. This is the motto of the French Revolution that has been acknowledged worldwide. And this is what has been attacked by the terrorists, because behind this monument is Bataclan street where the concert hall is located, the concert hall that became the target of the terrorist attack then with many victims.

And this place will become one of the sites for remembering for the French who have been mourning for three days in response to the terrorist action. It is now 5:00PM, and more and more people are coming here, more and more who approach this place to remember again what happened on Friday.

We see behind there is an action that is very interesting called “Free Hugs” they want to show that this is a city of love. This is famous as “Paris the City of Love” so the enthusiasm and efforts are to keep this title after the cruel terror attack. So before there was a panic, people ran from inside a café because there was news that there was a shooting at another place.

There was news, we don’t know if it was true or not. So, the mass of people that were before gathered in the field, all tried to get into the place and then all came into here. There were some that stepped on glass, someone knocked over a bottle, and people thought it was the sound of a shooting So there was a big panic, all of us lay flat on the ground, everything was all over, there was broken glass, chairs that fell over.

It was all because the people paniced, now we know that there was a great panic here. But there was news of a shooting in another place, because the mass of people paniced. It was a group of people who had experienced trauma with a terror attack. To the point that any news, however small, suddenly people try to save themselves.

The restaurant is now messed up, we can see from there the servers try to calm the atmosphere, they try to find the belongings of the customers so they are not stolen and they try to arrange the place again. We see that they are always busy, people didn’t pay and they all left, but they try to calm down the atmosphere.

Lots of people lost their cell phones, lost their laptops. Now they (waiters/servers) are locking the door so things are not stolen. They (servers) have been trained in case of mass panic, so they work to calm the situation. Don’t have more people come by, those outside stay outside, those inside stay inside. This is the situation. We are now told to leave this place.

All the glass is broken, the people go outside and run without paying for all of it, and they are forced to empty it out.. But, the staff here is very well trained for this situation, they know what they have to do There is a standard procedure which they must do, because of that they cleared the place.

The things that were inside had to be left, the people outside can’t come into to get their things, because it is not known which things belong to which person. The point is to evacuate everyone. And they have to fix this place. The shards of glasses and platesscattered because people ran, this happened when the mass from outside tried to save themselves by coming inside.

So, I’ve heard in the center of the city there was a shooting, but one eyewitness said “yeah” he heard a shot, another said “no” that was a noise not of a shot but only commotion But that was not here, that was another place, the center of the city somewhere else. But when there was a person who said there was a shot, all panicked and the mass dispersed.

And others saw people running so they started to run too. And maybe there was someone who knocked over a glass or bottle so that they also thought there was a shot. That was the cause of the panic, all crowded to the inside of this room to save themselves. . We see that everything is destroyed, here are glasses, and police are now arriving, and of course the restaurant experienced a loss

. But the cases like this are usually covered by insurance. They have to have insurance for cases like this. But they are going to immediately close this restaurant, so for tonight, this restaurant is finished. They are going to close, and there is a procedure that must be followed

Now, all are told to go outside, and we see that they immediately evacuated this place. Before it was really busy, there were a lot of people, the people experienced trauma with the terror attack and they thought it would be better to go home to their own houses. I think so, and people have started to go home, while they try to watch the TV news about what actually happened.

Now, the police must……and what is really serious for the police because they have to see the transportation for the residents is sufficient, so that no person waits for transportation They [Police] will order the buses that are not running to run to pick up people to their houses so they are not waiting around.

Now people go to the tram station to return to their home and it must be garunteed that they will be picked up immediately, they cannot be gathered again in one place where another panic could happen Because the tram station is filled with long narrow alleys. It could happen again. Usually the security forces already know what must be protected, what must be done immediately

Like before at the restaurant, the servers immediately know, there was not a shot there, but only panic and there was a procedure that had to be followed. But, of course people are still worried, still afraid. We see their faces, all are tense, because they are still afraid there will be a terror attack.
Even though the police are guarding everywhere, the field is still empty.
